note_en: The team's own assay protocol settles the layout. Its plate map has six columns (Red 220, Green 220, Red 510, Green 510, Red 3850, Green 3850 lux) over four rows; CcaSR sits in three rows of each green column and in one row of each red column, i.e. 9 green and 3 red, and step 4 aliquots the culture into twelve tubes.
note_zh: 隊內的實驗流程本身就定下了配置。Protocol/Optogenetic LPA Assay.docx 的 plate map 是六欄（紅 220、綠 220、紅 510、綠 510、紅 3850、綠 3850 lux）四列；CcaSR 在每個綠欄佔三列、每個紅欄只佔一列，即九管綠、三管紅，第 4 步也寫明分裝到十二管。

note_en: The protocol disagrees with itself and with the wiki. Its Figure 1 caption says the red lights are ALL at 168 lux while only the green vary (220, 510, 3850), but the plate map above it labels the red columns Red 220 / Red 510 / Red 3850 lux. The wiki's calculated 390 and 2,940 lux appear nowhere in the raw files.
note_zh: 流程本身就互相矛盾，也與 wiki 不符。Protocol/Optogenetic LPA Assay.docx 的圖 1 圖說寫紅光全部都是 168 lux、只有綠光變動（220、510、3850），但同一份的 plate map 卻把紅欄標成紅 220 / 紅 510 / 紅 3850 lux。wiki 推算的 390 與 2,940 lux 在原始檔中完全找不到。

note_en: The raw protocol corroborates the Measurement page, not the LPA page: its plate map sets the three green levels at 220, 510 and 3850 lux. No duty cycle, measuring position or kLux per-LED figure appears anywhere in the wet lab files, so the 2.33 to 2.42 kLux side of the conflict cannot be checked here.
note_zh: 原始流程支持 Measurement 頁而非 LPA 頁：其 plate map 把綠光三級設為 220、510、3850 lux。濕式實驗檔案中沒有任何佔空比、量測位置或逐顆 LED 的 kLux 數據，因此 2.33 至 2.42 kLux 這一邊無法在此查核。

note_en: The raw protocol has no 24 hour sampling point at all. Step 7 says incubate 8 to 10 hours total and step 8 samples every 2 hours at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 h, taking 200 uL per tube for OD600 and western blot. The 24 hour mark on the wiki is not in the protocol.
note_zh: 原始流程根本沒有 24 小時這個取樣點。第 7 步寫共培養 8 至 10 小時，第 8 步每 2 小時取樣（2、4、6、8、10 小時），每管取 200 µL 做 OD600 與 Western blot。wiki 上的 24 小時並不在流程裡。
